The cutting, notching and boring of wood members shall comply with Sections C101.1.1 through C101.1.5.
C101.1.1 Engineered wood products.
Cuts, notches and holes bored in trusses, structural composite lumber, structural glued-laminated members or I-joists are prohibited except where permitted by the manufacturer's recommendations or where the effects of such alterations are specifically considered in the design of the member by a registered design professional.
